messages:
Mira Patel: Hey team — onboarding question for a new contrib model (cobalt-6.1b) we want to serve. Quick checklist: weights location, tokenizer sanity, runtime config, and licensing/attribution. Planning to push to staging Dedicated.
Jun Park: Where are the weights stored? I only see a partial upload in weightstore. Path?
Alex Chen: S3 link: s3://redwood-models/cobalt/cobalt-6.1b/v1/weights.tar.gz. There was a separate manifest in weightstore (weightstore://projects/cobalt/6.1/v1) but the upload job failed midway yesterday — looks like a multipart part missing.
Mira Patel: Thanks. @eng-sre-bot can you confirm the weightstore replication state and whether we should prefer direct S3 pull for staging? :eyes:
eng-sre-bot: replication_status: partial, missing 1/8 parts for weightstore://projects/cobalt/6.1/v1. Recommendation: fall back to S3 path for now and re-run weightstore sync job.
Samir Gupta: Tokenizer note — tokenizer.json from the model archive has no explicit BOS token and uses an odd byte-level newline mapping. I ran the quick tokenization smoke test: `python -c \"from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('Hello\\nWorld'))\"` -> output token ids include 50256-like special id at end. Might be off-by-one compared to our tknzr wrapper.
Alex Chen: Good catch. Config in repo: `models/cobalt/config.json` shows \"vocab_size\": 50257, \"bos_token_id\": null. That null is probably the issue. I pushed a draft PR to set bos_token_id: 0 and fixed special ids mapping. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/models/cobalt/pulls/42
Jun Park: If we set bos_token_id to 0, ensure the runtime code doesn't assume 1-based indexing. Also check kv-cache shape behavior for seq_len mismatch; the model's config has \"n_positions\": 4096 but the tokenizer produces length 4098 for some inputs.
Mira Patel: Right — also need to validate `max_seq_len` in serving config. Samir, can you run the `runtime-config-validate` script from the repo against the patched config and the weights (S3 copy)? The script is `scripts/validate_serving.py --model models/cobalt --weights s3://...`.
Samir Gupta: Running now locally; will post logs when done.
Ava (Legal): Quick flag on licensing/attribution: the model card in the archive states \"Non-commercial use only\" in the top-level README, but the license file is MIT. Need clarification from the contributor — can't onboard with contradictory terms. Also require a model_card.md with the attribution and a preferred citation string.
Mira Patel: Oof, that's a blocker for Hosted/Dedicated public usage. For Private deployments we can accept as-is if customer signs extra TOU, but general policy needs model_card + explicit license that matches model_card text. Ava, what exact artifacts do you need?
Ava (Legal): Please get the contributor to: 1) Provide a license file that matches the \"Non-commercial\" restriction OR remove the contradictory line in model card; 2) Fill out our model_card template (see link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/model-card-template); 3) Confirm any third-party datasets used with attribution statements. Until then mark gating: \"licensing-pending\".
Alex Chen: I'll ping the contributor and request a corrected license and completed model_card. I can also attach the tokenizer patch in the same PR so they can re-upload cleaned weights.
eng-sre-bot: deploy_preview: staging cluster available. Note: firewall rule needed if weight pull uses S3 from weightstore account.
Jun Park: One more nit — quant config in `serve.yaml` sets `quant: dynamic_int8` but weights were exported in float16. Need conversion step in the ingestion pipeline or disable quant in the initial rollout.
Samir Gupta: Validate script finished: errors -> tokenizer BOS null, kv-cache shape mismatch for input length 4098, and serve.yaml quant mismatch. Created a local branch `cobalt-onboard-fixes` with fixes for config and a test harness: `tests/onboard/cobalt_smoke.py` (ran with the S3 weights). Logs: ```ERROR: tokenizer: missing bos_token_id
WARN: kv_cache: expected 4096 got 4098 -> will truncate at 4096
ERROR: quant: requested dynamic_int8 but weights not quantized -> skipping quant config```
Mira Patel: Good. Action items: Alex to get license + model_card from contributor; Samir to land tokenizer/config PR and attach smoke logs; Jun to coordinate weightstore resync with eng-sre; Ava to confirm gating state once license clarified. I'll mark the thread as the canonical async spot for updates.
Alex Chen: Will do — pinging contributor now. @Ava (Legal) I'll add you to the PR and drop the model_card template as a comment.
Ava (Legal): Thanks — set gating label to `licensing-pending` on the onboarding tracker.
Samir Gupta: PR pushed for tokenizer/config fixes: `r/models/cobalt/commits/fe3c9`. Requesting quick CR from @Jun and @Alex.
Jun Park: Reviewing now. Small suggestions inline, but nothing blocking.
Mira Patel: Thanks all. If we get license cleared and weightstore synced, target staging rollout tomorrow afternoon. If any regressions in the smoke run, post here. :thumbsup:
